query: What is the general rule as to the use of Form 10-K?
expected_answer: Form 10-K shall be used for annual reports pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 for which no other form is authorized.
ground_truth_concepts: annual reports pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d)

query: How many days does a large accelerated filer have to file Form 10-K after fiscal year end?
expected_answer: A large accelerated filer must file Form 10-K within 60 days after the end of the fiscal year covered by the report.

query: What is the filing deadline for an accelerated filer for Form 10-K?
expected_answer: An accelerated filer must file Form 10-K within 75 days after the end of the fiscal year covered by the report.

query: What is the filing deadline for non-accelerated filers for Form 10-K?
expected_answer: Non-accelerated filers must file Form 10-K within 90 days after the end of the fiscal year covered by the report.

query: Are electronic submissions of Form 10-K required to be filed via EDGAR?
expected_answer: Yes, reports on Form 10-K must be filed in electronic format via the EDGAR system.
